status: development-only prototype; not preregistered independent replication
target: signs of all pairwise differences between fixed finite-population mean scores
primary_outcomes: any wrong certificate anywhere in a run
unique mean-score cells needed to certify 90 percent of pairs
unique mean-score cells needed to decide all pairs
secondary_outcomes: certified fraction at 10, 25, 50, and 75 percent of full label cost
unresolved fraction and forced sample-mean ranking accuracy reported separately
area under the certified-fraction versus label-fraction curve

synthetic.unit_of_repeat: new synthetic finite matrix plus one shared uniform item permutation

real_development.systems: all 20 machine-system columns; no quality-based selection
real_development.claim_scope: randomization stability on one previously exposed fixed matrix, not generalization

gate.safety: proof plus implementation tests; flag any empirical violation and compare error-frequency uncertainty to alpha
gate.efficiency: do not promote unless shared_racing improves cost to 90 percent resolution by at least 10 percent versus both common_active and random_pair; still requires independent data and published strong baselines

exclusions: no Hayden private or collaborative data/code/results
no SAFE-EVAL code reuse or claimed novelty relative to that project
no new untouched test data evaluated
no fixed-95-percent intervals used with repeated uncorrected stopping
no total ranking advertised when comparisons are unresolved
